ios-feedback|Notifications.summary: A Plenix notification on iOS is a system notification (UserNotifications), drawn entirely by the system on the Lock Screen, in Notification Center and as a banner, with the app icon, SF Pro text and the system glass; no app can restyle it. Plenix sets what it says and offers: a short title-case title, a full-sentence body without the app name, neutral text when previews are hidden, up to four nondestructive actions with short labels and symbols, a thread so related ones stack, and an accurate badge count. While the app is in front, Plenix shows the news in place or in its own in-app banner, the Plenix toast: the toast surface, a 4-point radius, a tone edge, DM Sans text and a 44-point close button, shown in the Plenix rows.

anatomy.name: Title
